summary: Spok Holdings, Inc. filed a Form 8-K to report Q2 2026 financial results and declare a regular quarterly dividend of $0.3125 per share, payable September 9, 2026, to holders of record August 19, 2026. The earnings release also disclosed an agreement to sell narrowband licenses for $8 million, net income of $4.1 million, and adjusted EBITDA of $9.1 million. This is a routine earnings and dividend announcement, not a special situation. The license sale is minor and part of operations. No board recommendation, advisors, or deal terms beyond the disclosed dividend and license sale were provided. Watch for completion of the license sale and continued operational performance.
